facts.activity_series: responding to a loss of containment

assets.label: hydraulic energy accumulator
assets.service: stores hydraulic energy released at P-4104

control_failures.control_label: integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: unrelieved potential energy found after isolation of P-4104

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was never verified as effective, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the integrity of the mechanical seal support system on P-4104, ACC-4104 and M-4104 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. P-4104 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was never verified as effective. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 12 July 2026 a high potential incident was recorded on P-4104, ACC-4104 and M-4104 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during commissioning of replacement equipment; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
